subject.title: Telegram normal reply can start mid-URL / lose opening text when message begins with Markdown links (2026.5.27)

question: Should maintainers treat the merged shared Telegram fallback policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99861 as sufficient proof for this issue, or keep this issue tied to the open draft fix path until exact Telegram proof is added?
rationale: Current main has overlapping source-level fallback changes, but the live issue discussion still points to the open draft PR and there is no exact live current-main proof for the reported first-chunk Markdown-link symptom.

options.title: Keep tied to the active fix path
options.body: Leave this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93059 is rebased/repaired or replaced with exact proof, then close after the landed fix is verified.

options.title: Close after proving current main
options.body: If a maintainer verifies that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99861 fully covers the reported trigger, close this issue as implemented on main and close the stale draft PR as superseded.

recommendation.title: Keep tied to the active fix path
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93059 is rebased/repaired or replaced with exact proof, then close after the landed fix is verified.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged shared fallback policy that may supersede the open draft fix and are the strongest current source-history owner for the affected path.
